title: Woman with Sunglasses and Typographic Overlays
coreRelationships: The central figure of the woman is partially obscured and framed by the surrounding text.
The text elements are dynamically arranged, curving and overlapping, to fill the negative space around the figure.
The bright, almost glowing, sunglasses are a focal point, drawing attention to the woman's face.
The color palette of the text is warm and earthy, contrasting with the stark white background and the woman's bright, almost neon, skin tones.
The scale of the text varies significantly, with some words being very large and dominant, while others are smaller and more integrated.
reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast, stylized photograph of a person (preferably with a strong visual element like reflective eyewear) with a collage of dynamically arranged, curved, and overlapping text elements. Use a warm, earthy, and vibrant color palette for the text against a stark white background. Vary font sizes and colors to create visual hierarchy and movement, ensuring the text interacts with and frames the central figure.
